description.value: The One is a Taiwanese-Chinese restaurant on Kingsway in Burnaby, rooted in the Lao Shan Dong homemade noodle tradition that traces its origins to Taiwan in 1949. The menu centres on hand-crafted noodles served in a dine-in setting, and the restaurant also offers takeout. It presents itself as a family-friendly, all-ages destination with a lively café-style atmosphere.
